description: An eight-step sequencer with its own CV, time share and gate length for every step, plus chances to skip a step, reverse the order and change a setting at random

params.text: Adds a whole number of volts to every step's CV, -3 to +3, and is pulled back on its own if it would take the highest step above 6V
Quantizes the fractional part of each step's CV: none, twelve-tone, or quarter-tone
Shifts where the sequence starts by 0 to 7 places, and shifts it again by that much each time the sequence comes round
Sets the chance, up to 99%, that a step is passed over with its gate held low
Sets the chance, up to 100%, that the step order is turned back to front each time the sequence comes round
Sets the chance, up to 100%, that one setting on the panel is changed at random each time the sequence comes round
Sets how many bars the whole sequence is stretched over, 1 to 8
Sets the CV for step one, -3V to +6V
Sets the CV for step two, -3V to +6V
Sets the CV for step three, -3V to +6V
Sets the CV for step four, -3V to +6V
Sets the CV for step five, -3V to +6V
Sets the CV for step six, -3V to +6V
Sets the CV for step seven, -3V to +6V
Sets the CV for step eight, -3V to +6V
Sets how much of the bar step one takes; the eight of them are meant to add up to 100%
Sets how much of the bar step two takes; the eight of them are meant to add up to 100%
Sets how much of the bar step three takes; the eight of them are meant to add up to 100%
Sets how much of the bar step four takes; the eight of them are meant to add up to 100%
Sets how much of the bar step five takes; the eight of them are meant to add up to 100%
Sets how much of the bar step six takes; the eight of them are meant to add up to 100%
Sets how much of the bar step seven takes; the eight of them are meant to add up to 100%
Sets how much of the bar step eight takes; the eight of them are meant to add up to 100%
Sets how much of step one's own time its gate stays high, up to 99%
Sets how much of step two's own time its gate stays high, up to 99%
Sets how much of step three's own time its gate stays high, up to 99%
Sets how much of step four's own time its gate stays high, up to 99%
Sets how much of step five's own time its gate stays high, up to 99%
Sets how much of step six's own time its gate stays high, up to 99%
Sets how much of step seven's own time its gate stays high, up to 99%
Sets how much of step eight's own time its gate stays high, up to 99%
Pressing it scales all eight of the time-share knobs so that they add up to 100%

inputs.text: The clock the sequencer runs from: the time between two rising edges past 2V is taken as one beat, and four of those make the bar the time-share knobs divide
A rising edge past 2V sends the sequence back to its first step

outputs.text: The CV of whichever step is current, after quantizing and the OCT offset
10V while the current step's gate is high and 0V otherwise
Step one's CV, written only while step one is the current step and left at that value the rest of the time
Step two's CV, written only while step two is the current step and left at that value the rest of the time
Step three's CV, written only while step three is the current step and left at that value the rest of the time
Step four's CV, written only while step four is the current step and left at that value the rest of the time
Step five's CV, written only while step five is the current step and left at that value the rest of the time
Step six's CV, written only while step six is the current step and left at that value the rest of the time
Step seven's CV, written only while step seven is the current step and left at that value the rest of the time
Step eight's CV, written only while step eight is the current step and left at that value the rest of the time
10V while step one's gate is high, written only while step one is the current step
10V while step two's gate is high, written only while step two is the current step
10V while step three's gate is high, written only while step three is the current step
10V while step four's gate is high, written only while step four is the current step
10V while step five's gate is high, written only while step five is the current step
10V while step six's gate is high, written only while step six is the current step
10V while step seven's gate is high, written only while step seven is the current step
10V while step eight's gate is high, written only while step eight is the current step

notes: with nothing patched to CLOCK the module does nothing at all: no output is written and the sequence never advances
the eight time-share knobs are meant to add up to 100%; a blue lamp lights while they do not, and the button beside the bar count scales them until they do
a blue lamp above each step's jacks lights while that step's gate is high
pattern evolution moves a real control: whatever it picks changes on the panel and stays changed
